note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled offline as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read with translation.fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref). Every quotation, in the day's passage and wherever the prose quotes it again, is OWB verbatim: a whole verse or range where the English quotes one, otherwise the shortest contiguous OWB span that carries the quoted clause (an ellipsis marks words the English itself skips). Book names follow the Amharic library's citations.

Re-quoted 2026-11-18 from the 1962 Amharic Bible (UBS) and translator-rendered OT wording, per the founder decision that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Where the author's prose argues from a word OWB does not use, the prose was adjusted minimally or given a one-time gloss (e.g. Acts 4:36 «የሚያበረታታ ሰው», glossed «የመጽናናት ልጅ»; Ps 119:37 «በመንገዶችህ», bridged to God's word). block_index is chapter-local, counted the way the admin review panel splits a body (one block per closing p, li, blockquote or heading).
